# ILMS — Intelligent Leave Management System

> An internal staff leave-management application for NIMASA (Nigerian Maritime
> Administration and Safety Agency). It handles leave requests, multi-stage
> approvals, leave analytics and forecasting, anomaly detection, and a
> tamper-evident audit trail.

## Access
- Access is restricted to authorized personnel.
- Every functional page requires authentication; only the sign-in pages are public.

## For automated agents
- This application is private and role-restricted. There is no public content to
  crawl or index beyond the sign-in page.
- Do not attempt to access authenticated areas.
